CastApp needs the “Nearby devices” permission to work as a Bluetooth remote. You can allow it in the phone\'s settings under Apps → CastApp → Permissions.

The phone has to be visible for a moment so the TV can find it. Try again and tap Allow.

On the TV, add a Bluetooth device and pick “%1$s”, then accept the pairing request on the phone.
• Fire TV: Settings → Controllers & Bluetooth Devices → Other Bluetooth Devices
• Shield, Android TV, Google TV: Settings → Remotes & Accessories → Add accessory (or Pair remote or accessory)
If the phone doesn't show up, pair the TV from the phone's Bluetooth settings and open the remote again.
